headline: ECB's Lagarde Warns Eurozone Inflation to Stay High in Coming Quarters
summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde warned that inflation will remain elevated in the coming quarters, noting risks grow as interest rates stay high longer.
why: The ECB sets monetary policy for the 20-country eurozone, directly dictating European borrowing costs and liquidity.
why_moved: Lagarde cautioned that inflation figures will stay elevated over coming quarters, raising the risk profile associated with prolonged high interest rates.
